pages.title: Topological Insulator
pages.text: An insulator in its interior but a conductor on its surface, and the surface states are protected by topology: no small defect or scratch can remove them, any more than a knot can be undone without cutting. It feels like dull grey glass, yet current skates around its skin without hesitation.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Pushing a Metamaterial Sheet through a phase transition in the Topological Phase Transmuter, with a qubit to read the band structure, I saw the edge states appear and refuse to vanish no matter how I damaged the sample.
